page_title: CAN 1-1 BOS | Canada v Bosnia & Herzegovina 12/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Cyle Larin (Canada) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
90+5' Ali Ahmed (Canada) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nikola Vasilj, who smothers the ball.
90+3' Nikola Katic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+2' Facundo Tello blows his whistle and it's Promise David (Canada) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+1' Substitution. Stephen Eustaquio leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jonathan Osorio (Canada).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Nikola Vasilj.
90' Ivan Sunjic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) commits a rough challenge and Facundo Tello blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Canada.
85' Dzenis Burnic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
85' Bosnia & Herzegovina failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

85' The ball is cleared after Samed Bazdar (Bosnia & Herzegovina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Bosnia & Herzegovina force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
84' Sergej Barbarez is forced to make a change. Sead Kolasinac is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Dzenis Burnic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
81' Promise David (Canada) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
78' 1 - 1 Goal! Promise David plays it to Cyle Larin (Canada), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Nikola Vasilj. 1:1.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi will be replaced by Cyle Larin (Canada).
74' Sergej Barbarez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) replacing Amar Memic.
74' Substitution. Esmir Bajraktarevic will be replaced by Ivan Sunjic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
74' Ismael Kone (Canada) makes a rough challenge and Facundo Tello blows his whistle for a foul.
69' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
66' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) plants a goal-bound header towards the left post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
65' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
62' Here is a change. Ivan Basic is going off and Sergej Barbarez gives the last tactical orders to Armin Gigovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
62' It's time for a substitution. Samed Bazdar (Bosnia & Herzegovina) comes on in place of Jovo Lukic.
61' Substitution. Tajon Buchanan makes way for Ali Ahmed (Canada).
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Promise David (Canada) for Jonathan David.
61' Jesse Marsch has decided to make a change. Jacob Shaffelburg (Canada) replaces Liam Millar.
59' Tarik Muharemovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
58' Bosnia & Herzegovina have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Jonathan David (Canada) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
55' Benjamin Tahirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) swings in a cross from the corner, but Maxime Crepeau reads it well and gathers the ball.

55' Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) meets a cross inside the box, but Maxime Crepeau wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Bosnia & Herzegovina have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Luc De Fougerolles (Canada) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
53' A shot from inside the box by Richie Laryea (Canada) is deflected onto the post by one of the defenders!
50' Nikola Vasilj (Bosnia & Herzegovina) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
50' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) is able to continue to play.
49' Nikola Vasilj (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' The game is interrupted now, Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
49' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) is adjudged offside.
47' A pass from Jonathan David (Canada) is intercepted by Nikola Vasilj and the move breaks down.
46' Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Maxime Crepeau makes a comfortable save.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Derek Cornelius (Canada), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles over the bar. Poor effort.
45+3' Canada force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+3' Alistair Johnston (Canada) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45+1' Facundo Tello shows a yellow card to Jovo Lukic (Bosnia & Herzegovina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
44' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Benjamin Tahirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar.
42' Amar Memic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is penalised for a foul. Facundo Tello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
40' Canada take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
40' Liam Millar (Canada) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
39' The ball goes out for a corner. Canada can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
38' Canada can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

38' The ball falls for Jonathan David (Canada) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there! The ball goes behind for a corner. Canada will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
38' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) will deliver the corner kick.
34' The corner is swung in but Canada can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
34' Alistair Johnston (Canada) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
32' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.

32' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
30' Ismael Kone (Canada) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) takes a short free kick.

29' Tarik Muharemovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) was too forceful with his tackle and Facundo Tello interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Canada, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
29' Canada will take a corner kick.
28' Jonathan David (Canada) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
27' Sead Kolasinac (Bosnia & Herzegovina) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Facundo Tello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Canada win a free kick.
23' The referee blows for a cooling break.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Sead Kolasinac gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Jovo Lukic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) glances a header into the net. 0:1.
20' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bosnia & Herzegovina.

19' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Facundo Tello blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
19' Richie Laryea (Canada) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

17' It's unbelievable, Jonathan David (Canada) blows a huge opportunity! He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific daisy-cutter from point blank range. His first-time effort is directed towards the middle of the target, but Nikola Vasilj reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
16' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
15' Canada work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
14' Jonathan David (Canada) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Canada have a corner.
13' Jovo Lukic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) connects with the resultant free kick but produces a header straight at Maxime Crepeau.
11' A yellow card for a tackle by Alistair Johnston (Canada). Facundo Tello doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
10' Liam Millar (Canada) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
5' Jovo Lukic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
3' Amar Memic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
2' Alistair Johnston (Canada) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Facundo Tello blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Bosnia & Herzegovina.
2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Stephen Eustaquio (Canada), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
1' Luc De Fougerolles (Canada) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Now Canada have a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Canada will have the kick-off.
Facundo Tello will supervise the game today.
